provenance.geometry: authored procedurally in Blender by these scripts; no third-party or generated meshes
provenance.textures: walnut = W3 detail_lib.tex_walnut (identical pixels/names, de-duplicable by hash); limestone + trim palette authored with numpy in places_lib.py; no AI imagery

material_family: W3: Timber • oiled walnut, Ceramic • warm ivory, brass/bronze/graphite trim palette, Display • jade phosphor; W4 adds Stone • warm limestone and Panel • dark glass slot
panel_slot_contract: meshes named *_panel_slot use material "Panel • dark glass slot" with UV 0..1 across the front face; anchor_panel_slot gives centre, glTF normal and size_w_m/size_h_m

designed_minimums.interaction_standoff_m: 0.55-0.75 (anchor_interact) in front of every place asset
